overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. Hiring before contract approval is outside the OML, and the AG does not assess the truthfulness of individual statements made at meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board hired an Assistant Town Administrator without voting to approve the employment contract, and that the hire began before contract approval.
allegations.key_passage: That the Board may have appointed Ms. Mahoney to the position of Assistant Town Administrator without an actual contract in place or that she began employment with the Town prior to the Board actually approving the contract does not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board Chair made an untrue statement at the April 10 meeting about when the Assistant Town Administrator's contract was approved.
allegations.key_passage: While the Division of Open Government encourages honesty and candor during all meetings, we do not review statements made by individuals to determine their veracity.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
